description: This file defines the 'Document' class within the OpenCart system library namespace. It provides methods for managing page metadata such as title, description, keywords, as well as links, styles, and scripts. The class encapsulates properties and methods to set and get these elements, facilitating dynamic page content management.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a web page's metadata and resource links within the OpenCart system library.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds a hyperlink reference with relation attribute.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet link with optional relation and media attributes.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a script link with an optional position ('header' or 'footer').

methods.name: getScripts
methods.description: Retrieves scripts for a given position, defaulting to 'header'.
